soft-indigo.$description: Soft Indigo — Brand accent — iconography, stat markers, chart series, link states; the single chromatic note in an otherwise achromatic system

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — Deepest surface — modal backdrops, full-bleed image fills, inline SVG fills

carbon.$description: Carbon — Page canvas — the primary background; near-black with no warmth

graphite.$description: Graphite — Card surface — one step above the canvas to delineate content blocks

iron.$description: Iron — Elevated surface and border — secondary cards, table rows, subtle dividers

slate-edge.$description: Slate Edge — Hairline borders on imagery and nested elements — visible but recessive

smoke.$description: Smoke — Dark borders and separators for elevated surfaces and inverted UI. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

mist.$description: Mist — Disabled or low-emphasis button text

ash.$description: Ash — Secondary text — captions, metadata, helper text, muted labels

bone.$description: Bone — Primary text, icons, filled CTA background, card surface inverts; the dominant light element in the dark system

inter.$description: Primary typeface for headings, body, navigation, and buttons. Used at 64px/56px for display headlines with tight tracking, 40px for section headings, 24px/20px for subheadings, 16px for body and nav, 14px for captions. Weight 400 is the reading default; 500–600 for labels and emphasis. Negative letter-spacing tightens at scale (–0.036em at 64px tapering to –0.012em at 20px) — the optical correction keeps large display type from feeling airy.

jetbrains-mono.$description: All-caps category labels, section eyebrows (e.g. "HOW IT WORKS"), beta tags, and micro-text. Wide tracking (+0.071em to +0.083em) gives the type a stamped, technical feel — it reads as metadata, not copy. Sets it apart from Inter's proportional rhythm and signals the product's data/analytics domain.
